meta.name: prisma-upgrade-v7
meta.description: Complete migration guide from Prisma ORM v6 to v7 covering all breaking changes. Use when upgrading Prisma versions, encountering v7 errors, or migrating existing projects. Triggers on "upgrade to prisma 7", "prisma 7 migration", "prisma-client generator", "driver adapter required".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 升级 Prisma 项目到 v7 并解决兼容报错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的项目还在用 Prisma 6 且准备升级到 v7
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your Prisma project to v7 and fix breaking changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from Prisma 6 to v7 and hitting issues

howto.what: Claude 会按官方指南指导你从 Prisma v6 升级到 v7，一步步处理生成器、驱动适配器、配置文件、导入路径等所有破坏性变更，给出修改示例和命令，并提醒 MongoDB 项目不要适用此指南。
howto.when: 当你说出“upgrade to prisma 7”、“prisma 7 migration”等关键词，或要求升级 Prisma 版本、处理 v7 错误时触发。

say.text: 我想把 Prisma 从 v6 升到 v7，该改哪些文件？
say.note: 它会按顺序列出升级步骤。

say.text: 升级后导入 PrismaClient 报错，怎么解决？
say.note: 它会检查生成路径并提示重新 generate。

say.text: 怎么给 Prisma 7 配置 driver adapter？
say.note: 它会按数据库类型给出安装命令。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through the official Prisma v6→v7 migration: update packages, switch generator, add driver adapters, create prisma.config.ts, fix imports, and replace removed APIs. It also warns that MongoDB projects should not follow this guide.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to upgrade Prisma to v7, mention migration, report v7 errors, or use trigger phrases like "upgrade to prisma 7" or "prisma 7 migration".

say_en.text: I want to upgrade Prisma from v6 to v7. What changes are required?
say_en.note: It will list the upgrade steps in order.

say_en.text: Importing PrismaClient fails after upgrade. How do I fix it?
say_en.note: It will check output paths and suggest running prisma generate.

say_en.text: How do I set up a driver adapter for Prisma 7?
say_en.note: It will give install commands per database.
